variants.headline: Building job cancelled part-way
variants.body: The building job for {project}, undertaken by {builder}, has been cancelled part-way. Our assessment favours {target} over a verdict that confuses an adverse interpretation with an established fact.

variants.headline: Client abandons the construction plan
variants.body: The client has abandoned {project}, which {builder} was building. Our assessment favours {target} over a verdict that confuses an adverse interpretation with an established fact.

variants.headline: Unfinished work meets a cancelled project
variants.body: Construction of {project} by {builder} has been cancelled before completion. Our assessment favours {target} over a verdict that confuses an adverse interpretation with an established fact.
